newsitem.title: UK: LPC-Salomon Intl mandates Cit/UBS for $1 bn repo.
newsitem.headline: LPC-Salomon Intl mandates Cit/UBS for $1 bn repo.

text.p: LONDON, Sept 6 (LPC) - Citibank and UBS have won the mandate to arrange a $1 billion securities repurchase facility for Salomon Brothers International, the banks announced.
The mult-currency facility, which is being targetted at Salomon's existing relationship banks, will have a commitment period of 364 days.

Any repos outstanding at the end of the year may be extended into a term repo of one year. The facility, which is guaranteed by Salomon Brothers Holding Co., is for general corporate purposes and will finance the borrower securities inventory.
UBS is documentation and syndication agent, while Citibank is acting as collateral agent. Salomon Brothers International is one of the Salomon Brothers main subsidiaries in the UK.
